verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents installation methods (Docker Compose, npm, Helm) and configuration, but nothing about updating. It never mentions versioned releases, changelogs, migration notes, or a repair or rollback path. Installation docs are adjacent and do not count toward an update-safety story, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks
